note: #102: when two templates fit equally (Strength A and Strength B, both strength with the same fields), the coach asks which one instead of guessing.

known_bad.source: Constructed: the agent picks the first template without asking.
known_bad.why: Drafts the session with Strength A without asking which of the two fitting templates to use.
known_bad.answer: Your strength session is ready to save or review in Strength A: 50 min, effort 7, squat 3 × 5 at 100 kg.

question: Strength session today, 50 min, effort 7: 3 x 5 squats at 100 kg

must: Ask whether to use Strength A or Strength B (or without a template) before presenting a draft
must_not: Present the session as ready to save in one of the two templates without asking
